Markets rally on rate cut hopes

Stocks rose after investors priced in a possible interest rate cut this quarter.

Major indices closed higher across Europe and the Americas as bond yields eased. Analysts noted that inflation prints due next week could confirm or delay the expected policy shift.

Open-source models gain ground

Developers report faster iteration cycles with community-trained language models.

Teams shipping retrieval-augmented products said smaller open weights reduced hosting costs while keeping latency stable in production pilots.

Championship final ends in draw

The title match finished 1-1 after extra time, forcing a replay next week.

Both sides missed late chances before penalties were ruled out by tournament regulations, sending the fixture to a rematch on Sunday.

Coastal sensors track ocean warming

A new buoy network published mid-year temperature anomalies along the coast.

Researchers highlighted a 0.4°C anomaly versus the decade mean and plan to open the dataset to regional climate models this fall.
